Check to demand @since tag to be present on type javadoc.
Check to demand @since tag to be present on type and method javadocs. Matching tags produce no violation.

Check to demand @since tag to be present with digital value on method javadocs also in addition to default tokens. Missing @since tags and tag format violations are reported with the common severity property.

subsection.name: Description
subsection.div: Requires user defined Javadoc tag to be present in Javadoc comment with defined format. To define the format for a tag, set property tagFormat to a regular expression. Violations are reported only when the configured tag is missing or when the tag content does not match tagFormat. No violation is reported when the tag is present and matches tagFormat (or when tagFormat is not configured). No violation reported in case there is no javadoc. To forbid tags instead of requiring them, use IllegalBlockTag.

tr.td: Specify the regexp to match tag content.
Control when to print violations if the Javadoc being examined by this check violates the tight html rules defined at Tight-HTML Rules.

subset of tokens
INTERFACE_DEF , CLASS_DEF , ENUM_DEF , ANNOTATION_DEF , METHOD_DEF , CTOR_DEF , ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF , ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF , RECORD_DEF , COMPACT_CTOR_DEF .

subsection.name: Examples
subsection.p: Example of default Check configuration that do nothing.
To configure Check to demand @since tag to be present on type javadoc.
To configure Check to demand @since tag to be present on type and method javadocs. Matching tags produce no violation.

pre.code: <module name="Checker"> <module name="TreeWalker"> <module name="WriteTag"> <property name="tokens" value="INTERFACE_DEF, CLASS_DEF, ENUM_DEF, ANNOTATION_DEF, RECORD_DEF, METHOD_DEF" /> <property name="tag" value="@since"/> </module> </module> </module>

subsection.p: To configure Check to demand @since tag to be present with digital value on method javadocs also in addition to default tokens. Missing @since tags and tag format violations are reported with the common severity property.

pre.code: <module name="Checker"> <module name="TreeWalker"> <module name="WriteTag"> <property name="tokens" value="INTERFACE_DEF, CLASS_DEF, ENUM_DEF, ANNOTATION_DEF, RECORD_DEF, METHOD_DEF" /> <property name="tag" value="@since"/> <property name="tagFormat" value="^[1-9\.]+$"/> </module> </module> </module>

subsection.name: Violation Messages
subsection.p: All messages can be customized if the default message doesn't suit you. Please see the documentation to learn how to.
